description: The Austrian Federal Fire Brigade Association, ÖBFV, publishes an annual statistics sheet for the country's fire services, compiled from the provincial associations and linked from its downloads section. The 2025 sheet and news item read on 2026-09-28 give 4,752 fire brigades (4,438 volunteer, 308 company and 6 professional brigades) with counts by federal state, 357,187 members split into active, reserve and youth, and the number of women members; call-outs by type for each year from 2008 to 2025, with 254,598 in 2025, of which 164,518 were technical, such as traffic accidents, storms and floods, and 64,991 fires; and 10,775 people and 6,557 animals rescued, excluding Vienna and Vorarlberg. The news item attributes the drop of about 85,000 call-outs from 2024 to the absence of large storm and flood events. Coverage is Austria, nationally and by state, from 2008. Access is free as a PDF; no licence is stated. Caveats: the sheet is a graphic, so trend values must be read from charts, and the rescue figures omit two states. It supports emergency response and capacity studies, such as relating yearly technical call-outs to flood and storm seasons. Related record: the German fire service statistics.
